payload.summary: probe-answer-timing.mjs silently does nothing on Windows
payload.detail: The script runs main() only when import.meta.url === `file://${process.argv[1]}`, which never matches on Windows (file:///D:/... vs D:\...), so 'node scripts/probe-answer-timing.mjs --allow-provider' exits 0 with no output on the owner's PC. Found 2026-09-26; worked around by editing a temp copy. Fix: compare with pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href, and add a test.
